title: Daily AI Newsletter Weekly Recap — November 22, 2026
summary: Nvidia's leadership crisis hardened into an SEC probe and a reinstatement campaign that the board kept rejecting, then dragged the broader market into its worst week since the pandemic — catching Anthropic's own record-breaking IPO in the downdraft days after its debut. Agent safety failures piled up everywhere from autonomous cyberattacks to a rogue email-surveillance tool, prompting new defenses from OpenAI and Signal, while the research race produced both a physics proof and a one-day showdown between an Anthropic-Claude proof and an all-human Stanford team over the Riemann Hypothesis.
